_: ⭐⭐ THE FIRST VENDOR CAPTURE OF A PUBLISHED INDICATOR'S DRAWN OBJECTS. Read out of TradingView's own chart model (`graphics().dwgboxes()`), not from a screenshot and not recomputed by us.
_what: Every box `makuchaku's Trade Tools - Fair Value Gaps` draws on AMEX:SPY 1D, as TradingView's own primitive records: bar index, bar date, top and bottom price.
_script: corpus/committed/makuchaku039s-trade-tools-fair-value-gaps__b951deedc8.pine, Pine v4, unmodified except the study() title
_howCaptured: Pasted into the Pine editor on the UCT capture rig chart, Add to chart, then the study's `graphics().dwgboxes().get('boxes').get(false)._primitivesDataById` read directly. `graphics()._indexes` maps a primitive's x to a real bar index.
_transport: Returned through the browser extension, NOT the clipboard. `tools/visual_conformance/README.md` documents fetch and blob download as dead against tradingview.com's CSP and clipboard as the working route; an extension-returned value is a fourth route that avoids the machine-wide clipboard hazard entirely.

_receipt._: Computed in the page BEFORE transport and recomputed after assembly. The payload arrived in four slices and the receipt is what proves the reassembly was not silently wrong.

_boxFields: [leftDate, rightDate, top, bottom, leftBarIndex, rightBarIndex]. rightDate is null where the right edge extends past the last loaded bar.

_findings.maxBoxesCountDefault: ⛔⛔ TRADINGVIEW KEPT 50 BOXES. The script declares no `max_boxes_count`, so Pine's DEFAULT applies and the oldest boxes are DELETED as new ones are drawn. Our engine emitted 212 over 600 bars with no cap at all — so on a long history we draw boxes TradingView has already removed.
_findings.forwardEdgeIsTradingDays: ⛔⛔ `right = bar_index + 3` ADVANCES THREE TRADING SESSIONS, NOT THREE CALENDAR DAYS. Measured on two boxes whose right edge falls past the last loaded bar: ours landed on a Saturday and a Sunday, TradingView on the following Monday and Tuesday.
_findings.fieldSelectionIsExact: ⭐ On all 47 boxes whose left bar both engines share, the engine picked the same bar and the same OHLC field. Every numeric difference traces to `tests/fixtures/vendor/spy-1d-bars-3000-2026-09-13.json` carrying 2-decimal prices where TradingView carries four (712.3 vs 712.295) — zero bars in that fixture have more than two decimals.

_bounds: ⚠️ ONE SYMBOL, ONE TIMEFRAME, ONE SCRIPT, 300 vendor bars against our 600. The comparable window is 2026-04-06 (TradingView's oldest surviving box) to 2026-09-11 (our last bar). Nothing here measures a second symbol, an intraday timeframe, or a script whose boxes are deleted or mutated after creation.
